messages.subject: Project Indigo - Licence Agreement v1
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan, Amelia,

Please find the first draft of the Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement for Project Indigo. Key commercial terms reflect the term sheet (6% running royalty, £4.5m upfront, £750k minimum, 100% liability cap as a starting position). Schedules 1-4 cover the patents, know-how, royalty report form and warranties.

We look forward to your mark-up.

Best wishes,
Elena

Elena Marchetti | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
